rawContent: Not all survivors are safe to disclose or report their #MeToo story and they may never be. We need to advocate for survivors in all corners of the world and push forward the advancement of equality. We hope one day #WhyIDidntReport will no longer be a necessity.

In the lead up to #DayoftheGirl, our CEO @criseboro is encouraging everyone to ask why sexual harassment, gender discrimination and insecurity continue to be the normal for girls across Canada. https://t.co/h1ESXzQ2Zu #DefyNormal #MeToo
Our new survey results have been highlighted in this great piece. Check it out and share! https://t.co/f1jmqRRl13 #DayoftheGirl #MeToo
